title: Assembly of an ascending cokernel-pushout system
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $\mathcal I\subset\mathrm{Ob}(\mathcal A)$ contain the chosen zero object, $a\in\mathbf Z$, and $K$ a cochain complex [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with $K^n$ zero for $n<a$. Suppose that for $m\in\mathbf N$ we are given objects $X_m\in\mathcal I$, $Q_m$, epimorphisms $p_m:X_m\to Q_m$, monomorphisms $\alpha_m:K^{a+m}\to X_m$ and $\beta_m:C_K^{a+m}\to Q_m$, where $C_K^n=\operatorname{Coker}(d_K^{n-1})$, satisfying $\pi_K^{a+m}\beta_m=\alpha_m p_m$. Assume $p_0$ is an isomorphism. Suppose given $d_m:X_m\to X_{m+1}$ such that $d_mp_{m+1}=0$ and $p_{m+1}$ is a cokernel of $d_m$. For every $m$ suppose there are $P_m$, $u_m:K^{a+m+1}\to P_m$, $v_m:Q_m\to P_m$, and a monomorphism $j_m:P_m\to X_{m+1}$ such that the square with top $\bar d_K^{a+m}$, left $\beta_m$, right $u_m$ and bottom $v_m$ is a pushout [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and $u_mj_m=\alpha_{m+1}$, $p_mv_mj_m=d_m$. Then there are a cochain complex $I$ and a morphism $\iota:K\to I$ whose components are monomorphisms, with $I^n\in\mathcal I$ and $I^n$ zero for $n<a$, such that every induced map $C_K^n\to C_I^n$ is mono and for every $n$ there are $P$, $u:K^{n+1}\to P$, $v:C_I^n\to P$, and a mono $j:P\to I^{n+1}$ with $\operatorname{IsPushout}(\bar d_K^n,\bar\iota^n,u,v)$, $uj=\iota^{n+1}$, and $vj=\bar d_I^n$. Composition is written in diagrammatic order.

proof.text: Use the supplied local factorization of d_(m+1) through p_(m+1), together with d_m p_(m+1)=0, to prove d_m d_(m+1)=0. Form the natural-number cochain complex L with CochainComplex.of X d, then extend it by zero along ComplexShape.embeddingUpIntGE a. The extension selects literally X_m in degree a+m and the chosen zero object elsewhere, so membership holds even without closure of the specified set under isomorphism.

Compose the compatibility pOpcycles_K beta = alpha p with the pushout identity and the supplied factorizations to prove alpha_m d_m = d_K alpha_(m+1). This gives a morphism from the restriction of K to L using CochainComplex.ofHom. The liftExtend boundary condition follows because the only lower boundary is m=0 and K is zero in degree a-1. Lift to an augmentation K -> I. Its components are mono by cancellation against the canonical term isomorphisms above the bound, and because the source is zero below the bound.

Let E_m identify I^(a+m) with X_m. Prove that E_m p_m is a cokernel of the incoming differential of I: for m=0 this projection is an isomorphism and the incoming source is zero; for m+1 transport hcoker_m with CokernelCofork.isColimitOfIsColimitOfIff, cancelling the term isomorphism E_m. Uniqueness of cokernels supplies an isomorphism F_m from the opcycles of I to Q_m with pOpcycles_I F_m = E_m p_m. Cancelling pOpcycles_K identifies opcyclesMap(augmentation) F_m with beta_m, so the induced map is mono. Transport each given pushout with IsPushout.of_iso' along F_m, replacing v_m by F_m v_m and j_m by j_m E_(m+1)^(-1). The augmentation and differential equations follow from the term identifications and cancellation of pOpcycles_I.

Below a, both opcycles objects are zero since their projections are epimorphisms from zero objects. For every such degree n, including a-1, take P=K^(n+1), u=identity, v=zero and j=augmentation^(n+1). The left map between zero opcycles is epi and the right map is an identity, so IsPushout.of_vert_isIso_epi gives the pushout. Both factorization equations follow, the second because its source is zero. Every integer at least a is a+m for a natural m, so the positive-degree and lower-degree conclusions cover all degrees.

lean.statement: theorem exists_complex_of_cokernel_pushout_system (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] (𝓘 : Set C) (hzero : (0 : C) ∈ 𝓘) (a : ℤ) (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, n < a → IsZero (K.X n)) (X Q : ℕ → C) (p : ∀ m : ℕ, X m ⟶ Q m) (α : ∀ m : ℕ, K.X (a + m) ⟶ X m) (β : ∀ m : ℕ, K.opcycles (a + m) ⟶ Q m) (hmem : ∀ m : ℕ, X m ∈ 𝓘) (hepi : ∀ m : ℕ, Epi (p m)) (hmono : ∀ m : ℕ, Mono (α m)) (hβ : ∀ m : ℕ, Mono (β m)) (hcomm : ∀ m : ℕ, K.pOpcycles (a + m) ≫ β m = α m ≫ p m) (hinit : IsIso (p 0)) (d : ∀ m : ℕ, X m ⟶ X (m + 1)) (hzero_d : ∀ m : ℕ, d m ≫ p (m + 1) = 0) (hcoker : ∀ m : ℕ, IsColimit (CokernelCofork.ofπ (p (m + 1)) (hzero_d m))) (hsq : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ (P : C) (u : K.X (a + (m + 1 : ℕ)) ⟶ P) (v : Q m ⟶ P) (j : P ⟶ X (m + 1)), Mono j ∧ IsPushout (K.fromOpcycles (a + m) (a + (m + 1 : ℕ))) (β m) u v ∧ u ≫ j = α (m + 1) ∧ p m ≫ v ≫ j = d m) : ∃ (I : CochainComplex C ℤ) (ι : K ⟶ I), (∀ n : ℤ, Mono (ι.f n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, I.X n ∈ 𝓘) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, n < a → IsZero (I.X n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, Mono (opcyclesMap ι n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ (P : C) (u : K.X (n + 1) ⟶ P) (v : I.opcycles n ⟶ P) (j : P ⟶ I.X (n + 1)), Mono j ∧ IsPushout (K.fromOpcycles n (n + 1)) (opcyclesMap ι n) u v ∧ u ≫ j = ι.f (n + 1) ∧ v ≫ j = I.fromOpcycles n (n + 1))
